deferral_condition: Independently accepted viable prompt-closeout schedule, root-reserved resources/attention/source-coordination preparation; if unavailable, F readiness HOLD. Source acceptance itself is not scheduling evidence or build permission.

independent_consultation.agreed: Exact timing distinction, controls nonwaiver, prompt-closeout feasibility/HOLD qualification
independent_consultation.channel: Collaboration message after checking cited frozen contract
independent_consultation.not_claimed: Fresh runner source approval, actual C-instance acceptance, runtime observation or cryptographic role authentication

mandatory_closer_controls: Required source-bound LC-C05/06 meaningful effects remain unexecuted and must be separately admitted and reconciled before actual closer C-instance/invocation. Runner controls do not substitute.
postrun_actual_gates: Original allocations, complete original journal/launcher, stop or positive no-Gradle, source/evidence/directory/device/lock seals, both role-correct C01-C07 acceptances and separately reviewed outer closer launcher before one actual invocation.
prebuild_explicit_contract: Independent prompt-closeout design/source acceptance; actual runner meaningful controls and role-correct F admission separately required. No historical explicit closer-test-before-build condition is invented.
recommended_sequence: Perform bounded closer controls before the build to reduce risk of stranded generated outputs.
resources_and_cleanup: Only bounded source/data reads and two compact permanent review files; no cache/runtime/build/test/helper import/compile/deletion/signaling or persistent process. Wrapper stop not applicable.
